ROCKSTAROS / DEVELOPER PREVIEW

OS Installation Guide

The public RockstarOS installer has not been released. The current guide covers the Developer Preview running in a virtual environment on Mac.

Current distribution status

Public downloads and installation will remain unavailable until signed release artifacts and verification keys are ready. The finished smartphone OS and avocadoMini hardware are also not yet available.

01 / TARGET ENVIRONMENT

Try the Developer Preview on Mac

The accepted environment is an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15.7.4 with a Lima 2.2.0 virtual machine. It requires Python 3.11 or later, OpenSSL 3, and at least 10 GiB of free space. This guide does not initialize a device or write the OS to physical hardware.

02 / INSTALLATION AND RECOVERY

Follow the canonical procedure

Verify the release version, hash, and signature before installation. The development repository documents saved-state verification, clean shutdown, backup, and recovery.

Full installation and recovery guide ↗

03 / WEB ACCESS

About the web OS interface

The web OS interface will move to a separate site from the product page. Access details will appear here once the requirements for public use are defined.
